# Amazon results: model setups and the professor's questions (amazon)

Pilot budget (LightGBM, logistic regression, CatBoost; 10 tuning trials; seed 555), 3 grouped split repeats (5 for B, E2 and E3 at sizes 8, 16 and raw 64), test PR-AUC of each setup's Model A (no-skill 0.095). Verdict rule, fixed before the runs: **supported** if Δ > 0 on every split, mean Δ > SD, and the Nadeau–Bengio corrected t-test over the grouped training CV folds (5 per split) gives p < 0.05. Otherwise a positive mean is **not distinguishable from zero** and a negative mean is labelled **worse**; p is two-sided, so a "worse" with p ≥ 0.05 is a lower mean, not a significant drop. Where a contrast has 3- and 5-split verdicts, the 5-split one is shown (decided 2026-10-28). Source: docs/RESEARCH_PLAN.md §11 and the results database.

## 2. The professor's questions (2026-10-21)

### Embedding size (and DeepTune)

Training CV (Z1, split 0, without f19; gnnrand averaged over 5 initialisations), PR-AUC by embedding size d:

| d per relation | gnnssl | gnnrand |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0.642 | 0.634 |
| 4 | 0.662 | 0.653 |
| 8 | 0.688 | 0.673 |
| 16 | 0.696 | 0.697 |
| 32 | 0.695 | 0.699 |
| 64 | 0.699 | 0.701 |
| raw | 0.696 | 0.702 |

Effective rank of the 64-d embedding (U-P-U / U-S-U / U-V-U): gnnrand 30 / 18 / 18; gnnssl 24 / 7 / 15.

Test, without f19 (Δ vs B):

| Size per relation | E2 (DGI) − B | E3 (untrained) − B |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | +0.109 ± 0.017 (supported, p = 0.00074, 3 splits) | +0.123 ± 0.025 (supported, p = 0.00027, 3 splits) |
| 4 | +0.112 ± 0.033 (supported, p = 0.0002, 3 splits) | +0.129 ± 0.021 (supported, p = 0.00026, 3 splits) |
| 8 (default) | +0.133 ± 0.016 (supported, p = 3.2e-05, 5 splits) | +0.128 ± 0.013 (supported, p = 1.6e-05, 5 splits) |
| 16 | +0.150 ± 0.025 (supported, p = 5.4e-06, 5 splits) | +0.131 ± 0.016 (supported, p = 2.8e-07, 5 splits) |
| raw 64 | +0.150 ± 0.022 (supported, p = 9.3e-07, 5 splits) | +0.159 ± 0.018 (supported, p = 7.1e-07, 5 splits) |

Against the default size 8. By the size rule, fixed before the runs, a size below 8 is enough if its E − B is supported and 8 − d is not; a size above 8 is needed only if d − 8 is supported:

| Contrast | E2 (DGI) | E3 (untrained) |
|---|---|---|
| 8 − 2 | +0.021 ± 0.006 (not distinguishable from zero, p = 0.42, 3 splits) | +0.004 ± 0.008 (not distinguishable from zero, p = 0.46, 3 splits) |
| 8 − 4 | +0.018 ± 0.012 (not distinguishable from zero, p = 0.89, 3 splits) | -0.002 ± 0.003 (worse, p = 0.53, 3 splits) |
| 16 − 8 | +0.016 ± 0.012 (not distinguishable from zero, p = 0.37, 5 splits) | +0.003 ± 0.021 (not distinguishable from zero, p = 0.21, 5 splits) |
| raw 64 − 8 | +0.016 ± 0.008 (not distinguishable from zero, p = 0.53, 5 splits) | +0.031 ± 0.013 (supported, p = 0.019, 5 splits) |

DeepTune has no label-free reducer for tabular or graph embeddings (its embeddings come from label-trained models; its autoencoder is image-only), so it was not used; an autoencoder in place of PCA (E4) is optional.

## 3. The research questions

### RQ1: how much does the f19 leak drive Amazon results?

- F4, dropping f19 (B without f19 − B all 25): -0.379 ± 0.024 (worse, p = 3.4e-11, 3 splits)
- Graph gain by feature variant (E1 − B / E2 − B):
  - all 25: +0.010 ± 0.008 (supported, p = 0.013, 3 splits) / +0.011 ± 0.002 (not distinguishable from zero, p = 0.09, 3 splits)
  - without f19: +0.163 ± 0.023 (supported, p = 9.7e-06, 3 splits) / +0.133 ± 0.016 (supported, p = 3.2e-05, 5 splits)
  - without #36: +0.162 ± 0.026 (supported, p = 6e-07, 3 splits) / +0.129 ± 0.034 (supported, p = 6.1e-06, 3 splits)

### RQ2: is the graph gain real structure? (without f19)

- Degree (N1 − B): +0.112 ± 0.024 (supported, p = 0.0003, 3 splits)
- Neighbour columns on a random graph (N2 − N1): -0.025 ± 0.006 (worse, p = 0.1, 3 splits)
- Real structure (E1 − N2): +0.076 ± 0.007 (supported, p = 0.00069, 3 splits)
- Beyond degree (E1 − N1, secondary): +0.051 ± 0.004 (supported, p = 0.0009, 3 splits)

Training-CV probe (split 0): own (B) 0.498; + deg (N1) 0.630; + nbr (E1) 0.719; + nbr, rewired (N2) 0.627.

### Full budget (6 classifiers, 100 trials; split 0 only, descriptive)

Test PR-AUC: B [without f19] 0.516; B [without f19, full budget] 0.525. Contrasts are in section 4; one split gives no verdict.
